method: Full five-case pack with ten genuinely independent fresh Codex CLI workers, one guided and one baseline per case, all using gpt-5.4-mini at high effort. Each condition used the same natural prompt and declared fixture snapshot in a neutral root. The guided variant loaded the target skill at the neutral task-quality path; the baseline had no .agents guidance tree and received no target-skill identity. Each worker ran inside an outer macOS sandbox-exec/seatbelt profile that allowed its own root and required harness runtime files while denying shared temporary storage, other evaluation roots, the catalog checkout, worktrees, memory, and parent-only traces; the inner Codex sandbox bypass was used only under that outer profile. Parent-side probes verified pwd, local manifests, denied parent traversal, and denied shared-temp/catalog/memory access before grading. Stdout, stderr, and session JSONL stayed in a parent-only ignored directory. Baseline trace scans found no target-skill identity or evaluation metadata. An interrupted gpt-5.6-luna case-2 pair was excluded and not combined with this run.

protocol_evidence.parent_probe: all workers had denied parent traversal and denied shared-temp/catalog/memory access
